_doc: QNFO-PORT-1 inventory (owner, 2026-11-14: the QNFO mechanisms that make the fleet close its own loops must run in Ultrastable as code). One row per mechanism: the QNFO rule and source it comes from, the foundation module that runs it, its status before this port and now, the test, and where it is wired into a clock. `python3 -m foundation sauce --check` (checks.yml) fails a row marked ported whose module, test or wiring is missing; tests/foundation/test_sauce.py holds the same rule. `config` is read by the module itself. `priority` orders the remaining work (1 first). Status is measured from code: ported = module + wired into a tick or executor + test; partial = some of it; missing = none.

mechanisms.status_before_why: foundation/queue.py run() closed an item when its probe passed, with no relapse reopen, no hold after a reopen and no ledger; the Worker reopened only failure-mode items (seed/worker/src/selfaudit.js)
mechanisms.feeds_criticality: relapsed and unusable-probe items are ignition gaps

mechanisms.status_before_why: the Worker tick filed a BREACH item per metric and closed it on recovery (seed/worker/src/tick.js); no remedy efficacy, no replacement of a remedy that did not move its metric, no guard regression rule
mechanisms.feeds_criticality: a metric with no untried lever and a guard regression are ignition gaps

mechanisms.qnfo_rule: ISSUE-THROUGHPUT-1, doctrine section 6 (issue_lifecycle, no silent drop)
mechanisms.status_before_why: no per-family inflow/outflow, no lifecycle ledger; an item deleted while open left no trace
mechanisms.feeds_criticality: a family with net inflow and no doer, and silent drops, are ignition gaps

mechanisms.status_before_why: OL-PR items closed only through their own probe (loopowner --closed) on the queue run; no general About/Superseded-by fold and no fold ledger
mechanisms.feeds_criticality: a dangling reference is an ignition gap
FAILURE-RESOLVE-1: a failing detector files Q-AUDIT-<id> on main, inside foundation/queue.items, with a cmd: closing probe; the executor takes it and the contracts loop closes it

mechanisms.status_before_why: deploy/deploy-workers.mjs records live_matches_commit per deploy and criticality counts only verified deploys, but no per-worker probes.json baseline and no automatic revert of a deploy that broke a probe that passed before
mechanisms.feeds_criticality: the verify clause counts deploys whose live code equals the commit
mechanisms.next: foundation/deployprobe.py: per-worker probes.json, baseline before deploy, regression after -> git revert of the deploy commit plus a redeploy, one level; feeds Verify and ignition

mechanisms.qnfo_rule: REVIEW-GATE-1 (two disjoint model families, High only when both agree with an added-line evidence)
mechanisms.status_before_why: scripts/llm_review.py holds a PR on a High finding from one model; one family can hallucinate a hold, and there is no agreement rule
mechanisms.next: second family in scripts/llm_review.py, hold only on a High both report whose evidence is an added diff line

mechanisms.qnfo_rule: QUEUE-SLA-1, SLA-120M-1 (queue_sla, v_stuck_summary by age, automatic fix per stuck type)
mechanisms.status_before_why: foundation/clockwork.py measures per-stage freshness with a catch-up ladder; no per-queue age of the oldest item and no automatic fix per stuck type
mechanisms.next: foundation/queuesla.py: age of the oldest open item per family from ops/issue-lifecycle.jsonl against a minute SLA, one automatic fix per stuck type
